statement: Rapamycin fed to genetically heterogeneous mice beginning at 600 days of age extended median and maximal lifespan in both sexes.

context.model: genetically heterogeneous mice, treatment started late in life

replication.note: Interventions Testing Program: three independent sites by design, and reproduced since.

limitations: long-term immunosuppression is the obvious translational obstacle
